pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 01/01/2027

At Veg chennai Srilalitha, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled in a safe and responsible manner. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website or place an order with us.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Website usage data (such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited)
  • Personal details such as your name, phone number, email address, and delivery address
  • Payment information (processed securely through third-party providers; we do not store full card details)
  • Order history and preferences

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Communicate with you regarding your orders or inquiries
  • Improve our website, services, and customer experience
  • Send promotional offers or updates (only if you opt in)

Sharing Your Information

We do not sell or rent your personal data. However, we may share your information with:

  • Authorities if required by law
  • Payment processors to securely handle transactions
  • Delivery partners to fulfill your order
  • Service providers who help operate our website and business

Data Security

We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. However, no online system can be completely secure.

Cookies & Tracking

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze traffic, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request corrections or updates
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Withdraw consent for marketing communications

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details below.

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us at:
Email:  vcsramersham@gmail.com.
Phone: +0149 497 2550
Address: 94, sycamore Road, Amersham, HP6 5EN.

pages.title: Outdoor Catering
pages.content:
Authentic 100% Pure Vegetarian Catering

Authentic 100% vegetarian catering in UK, backed by 21+ years of experience. Proud to have catered to all the VIPs and VVIPs of Indian origin across the UK. Perfect for weddings, corporate events, housewarmings, and temple functions. Enjoy live dosa stations, soft idlis, crispy vadas, and traditional banana-leaf feasts with sambar, rasam, poriyal, and payasam—freshly prepared for a truly authentic and memorable experience.

Standard Menu

Idly Or Veg Biryani, Meduvada (Live), Masala Dosa (Live), Plain Dosa(Live), Onion Dosa (Live), PodiDosa (Live), Onion Uthappam (Live), Capsicum Uthappam (Live), Chilli Uthappam (Live), Plain Uthappam (Live), PodiUthappam (Live), Coconut chutney, Tomato & Onion Chutney and Sambar.

Price :
Minimum call out charge for Live Dosa Station for a Weekend is £480/ up to 40 people (£480/ can be reached by the number of people or by the menu), Minimum call out charge for Live Dosa Station for a Weekday is £385/ up to 35 people (£385/ can be reached by the number of people or by the menu).

Week days (Monday to Friday) : £11.00/ per person, 35 people minimum.
Week Ends & Bank Holidays : £12.00/ per person , 40 people minimum.

WHAT WE BRING ?
We shall bring all the equipment necessary for cooking, Bain Marie to keep food hot and we will also bring disposable compartment plastic plates (9 inches), spoons and serviettes. We don’t bring drinking water or water glasses.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU ?
One Serving table of any size, one power plug point and 50to 60 square feet or 3×3 meters empty space for cooking with shade or cover on top and lighting. (Empty space can be at any part of your Home, Viz., Kitchen/Garage/dining room etc.,)

To confirm the booking 50% deposit needs to be paid and the balance by cash after the event is over.

We stay serving food at your premises for two hours and we need half an hour to set up (exclusive of set up time).

Upgrades
  • Upgrade Your Menu With A Gazebo at an extra cost of £70/.
  • Upgrade Your Menu With A Waiter for Serving at an extra cost of £70/.
  • Upgrade Your Menu With Crockery (Ceramic plates / Ceramic Bowls / Steel Spoons) at an extra cost of £3.00 / per person.
  • Upgrade Your Menu With Extra Hour For Serving/Cooking At A Cost Of £100/ Per Hour.
  • Upgrade Your Menu With More Dishes From The Below List At An Extra Cost.

Standard Menu

Price :

to 40 people (£700/ can be reached by the number of people or by the
menu), Minimum call out charge for Live Dosa Station for a Weekday is

 One Dessert (from the below mentioned list).
 One Main Course Dish, (from the below mentioned list).
 Will Stay for Three Hours instead of Two Hours.
 Weekdays (Monday to Friday) : £16.50/ per person, 35 people
minimum.
 Week Ends & Bank Holidays : £17.50/ per person, 40 people
minimum.

 

Madras Thali or South Indian Meals or Andhra Bhojanam

  • Plain Rice, sambar, rasam, koottu, poriyal, kaarakolambu, sweet, pappad, yoghurt, pickle veg kurma and one poori (1).
  • Option for sambar, aubergine, lady finger, tinde, capcicum / potato / carrot.
  • Options for rasam are, garlic, pepper, lemon and pineapple.
  • Options for koottu are cabbage, tomato, nine dhalls, pappali, sorakka.
  • Options for poriyal are cabbage, mix veg, potato, raddish.
  • Options for kaarakolambu are ennakathirikka (guthivankaya), lady finger, paruppuurundai, pakoda, potato.
  • Options for Sweet are Pineapple/apple/banana Kesari or Semiya/sabhudhana/rice Kheer.

PRICE : £10.99/ PER PERSON.

Additions :

Bisibela Bath, Bagala Bath, Lemon Rice, Sambar Rice, Puliyodarai(Tamarind Rice), Curd Rice, Veg Biriyani, Veg Pulao, Panner Fried Rice, Jeera Rice, Veg Fried Rice, Veg Noodles, Hakka Noodles, Szechuan Noodles, Gulab Jamun, Rasa Malai, Rasa Gulla, Pineapple / Apple / Banana / Plain Kesari, Semiya / Sabudhana / Rice kheer, Badam Halwa, And VegChennai Srilalithas special Moar Kolambu with fried lady finger, raw banana.(matoki) and Avial Or any other item from the below mentioned list.

*price will change when more items are added to the Madras Thali.

Whether you’re craving the best dosa restaurant in Amersham or looking for 100% pure vegetarian catering services for events, we bring quality, purity, and tradition to every plate—right here in the heart of Amersham.

Frequently Asked Questions

Veg Chennai SriLalitha brings the authentic taste of Chennai to London with home-style vegetarian cuisine served in a warm, fine-dining atmosphere. Our chefs from Chennai prepare traditional recipes with fresh ingredients and authentic techniques.

Where is Veg Chennai SriLalitha Amersham located?

We are located at 94 Sycamore Rd, Amersham HP6 5EN, United Kingdom

Is parking available at your locations? Yes, all our locations have nearby parking facilities. Some locations offer dedicated parking, while others have street parking and public car parks within walking distance.

pages.title: Cookies Policy
pages.content:
Cookie Policy

Effective Date: 01/01/2027

This Cookie Policy explains how Veg Chennai Srilalitha uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. They help websites function properly, improve user experience, and provide information to website owners.

How We Use Cookies

We use cookies to:

  • Ensure our website functions correctly
  • Remember your preferences (such as location or previous orders)
  • Improve website performance and user experience
  • Analyze website traffic and usage patterns
  • Support marketing and promotional activities (where applicable)

Types of Cookies We Use

Essential Cookies: These cookies are necessary for the website to operate and cannot be switched off. They enable core functions such as security, page navigation, and access to secure areas.
Performance & Analytics Cookies: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting anonymous information such as page visits and traffic sources.
Functionality Cookies: These cookies allow the website to remember your choices (such as language or region) to provide a more personalised experience.
Marketing Cookies: These cookies may be used to deliver relevant advertisements and track the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.

Third-Party Cookies

We may allow third-party services (such as analytics providers or payment processors) to place cookies on your device. These third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies, and we do not control their use of cookies.

Managing Cookies

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. You can
Delete existing cookies
Block certain or all cookies
Set preferences for specific websites
Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology or legal requirements. Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us at:
Email:  vcsramersham@gmail.com.
Phone: +0149 497 2550
Address: 94, sycamore Road, Amersham, HP6 5EN.
